evidence.why: Ingest manifest shows 3400 rows read but only 1893 loaded for 2026-10-21, indicating rows disappeared during processing.

next_checks: Inspect loader processing logic for why rows were suppressed/dropped despite being read.
args.root_cause: While checking logs, the loader encountered suppressed/ignored inserts (E_INSERT_SUPPRESSED) resulting in a large drop in loaded rows compared to rows read.
args.suggested_fix: Investigate why row inserts were suppressed when on_insert_error=ignore is set in the loader configuration.
